column1: # JSON bench per-iteration baselines.
# Format (tab-separated):
#   <metric>\t<max_per_iter_us>\t<note>
# Metrics correspond to lines `bench/json_bench.rb` emits:
#   `parse`       — `JSON.parse(JSON_BYTES)` over the synthetic 3.4 KB
#                   payload, native (serde::Visitor) path.
#   `generate`    — `JSON.generate(OBJ)` compact-form emit.
#   `round_trip`  — `JSON.generate(JSON.parse(JSON_BYTES))`. Sensitive
#                   to GC churn — guards the threshold tuning shipped
#                   in commit fc524f8b.
# Budgets are PER-ITER MICROSECONDS (`per_iter` column the bench
# prints; 5000 iters × 3 runs, min total / iters). Bench is run with
# `--features default,stdlib,_http_server,_fiber,_json_native` so the
# accelerator path is the one being gated; the pure-Ruby canon is
# ~200× slower and is not represented in this gate (would be a noise
# floor, not a regression detector).
# Initial budgets calibrated 2026-06 on ARM macOS local (parse ~17 µs,
# generate ~14 µs, round_trip ~40 µs) with ~3× headroom for CI runner
# variance (shared Linux x86 hosts on GitHub Actions can be 2–3× slower
# than local Apple Silicon at the same workload). Ratchet down once
# two consecutive CI runs settle below the budget — same etiquette as
# `perf/baselines.tsv`.
# Bumping etiquette (when a real regression is intentional):
#   1. Run the bench locally on the PR branch, capture per_iter µs.
#   2. Edit this file. The comment immediately above the row must
#      record: the new value, the prior value, the commit / PR that
#      drove the change, and one-line "why" (so future readers
#      reading `git blame` don't reverse-engineer the rationale).
#   3. NEVER bump for CI noise alone — bump RUNS or ITERS in the
#      check script first to reduce noise. Bumping the budget for
#      noise hides real regressions later.
# Metric         max_us  note
parse              50    initial — local ~17 µs ARM mac, 3× CI headroom
generate           50    initial — local ~14 µs ARM mac, 3× CI headroom
round_trip         150   initial — local ~40 µs ARM mac, ~4× CI headroom (GC variance is higher on round_trip — see fc524f8b)
